reason: The design has flaws: an unjustified central-region subsample, only some of the pre-period confounders controlled, and 1% outcome trimming. But the null holds when I re-estimate on all 2000 firms with every 2020 control: the coefficient is -0.28 (SE 0.24, p=0.25). The unadjusted association of +1.6 disappears once the pre-period controls are added. 'No effect' is therefore supported, though the report should note the region choice and say the result is a precise null, not proof of zero.
